description:
SATIF Histórico is an independent project from Chilecito, La Rioja, Argentina, focused on satellite-based wildfire monitoring.

Led by a volunteer firefighter with experience in Python, Google Earth Engine, NASA FIRMS, and GIS.

Our goal is to develop a web application that harmonizes MODIS and VIIRS fire detections, analyzes historical patterns, and provides useful information for wildfire prevention and emergency management.
